blocks.raw: # Enable tracking of clicked links
blocks.text: Enable tracking of clicked links

blocks.raw: When a campaign message containing a link is sent to users, Capillary checks the message content and verifies whether Enable Link Tracking is enabled.
blocks.text: When a campaign message containing a link is sent to users, Capillary checks the message content and verifies whether Enable Link Tracking is enabled.

blocks.raw: If link tracking is enabled:
blocks.text: If link tracking is enabled:

blocks.raw:
* The system replaces the original link with a custom Capillary tracking URL. This allows you to track user interactions, such as the number of users who clicked the link.
* When a user clicks the link, they are redirected to the intended destination.
* Since the system uses a Capillary tracking URL, it records and tracks the number of users who clicked the link before redirecting them.
blocks.text: The system replaces the original link with a custom Capillary tracking URL. This allows you to track user interactions, such as the number of users who clicked the link.When a user clicks the link, they are redirected to the intended destination.Since the system uses a Capillary tracking URL, it records and tracks the number of users who clicked the link before redirecting them.

target.note: normalise `*`/`+` markers to `-`

blocks.raw: If link tracking is disabled, the system sends the message with the original link and no tracking data is collected.
blocks.text: If link tracking is disabled, the system sends the message with the original link and no tracking data is collected.

blocks.raw: To track the link (URLs or web links) clicks sent through messages, you need to do the following:
blocks.text: To track the link (URLs or web links) clicks sent through messages, you need to do the following:

blocks.raw:
1. On the Engage+ home page, click the settings icon and navigate to the **Messages** page.
2. Enable the **Enable link tracking in messages** toggle button.

   <Image align="center" border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/2b13069bb30b835c822af90368f8f3fc60bc53b9c7460fb8617826bedfd2391f-image.png" className="border" />
blocks.text: On the Engage+ home page, click the settings icon and navigate to the Messages page.Enable the Enable link tracking in messages toggle button.

target.note: normalise `*`/`+` markers to `-`

blocks.raw:
> 📘 Note
>
> * Link tracking is available for all links across all engagement channels on Campaigns and Journeys. This includes links added to all input fields such as the email subject, CTA buttons and media content.
> * Unsubscribe clicks are not counted as general Call To Action (CTA) clicks. For example, if a user receives an email and clicks the Unsubscribe link it will not be considered as a general CTA click.

blocks.raw: # Set up communication limits for each channel
blocks.text: Set up communication limits for each channel

blocks.raw: When you run several campaigns at once, there’s a risk that the same customer may receive too many messages, either on the same day or across multiple days resulting in customer dissatisfaction. To prevent this, you can limit the number of messages to be sent for each communication channel and overall messages. This is set up at the organisation level. For each channel, you can set daily, weekly, and monthly limit with no maximum limit.
blocks.text: When you run several campaigns at once, there’s a risk that the same customer may receive too many messages, either on the same day or across multiple days resulting in customer dissatisfaction. To prevent this, you can limit the number of messages to be sent for each communication channel and overall messages. This is set up at the organisation level. For each channel, you can set daily, weekly, and monthly limit with no maximum limit.

blocks.raw: **Access Requirements**
blocks.text: Access Requirements

blocks.raw: By default, users do not have access to enable the communication limits feature for an org. If authenticated users need access, raise a JIRA ticket and assign it to the Engage+ Developer team.

blocks.raw: Time Period Definitions:
blocks.text: Time Period Definitions:

blocks.raw:
* Day = From 12:00 AM to 11:59 PM (same calendar day)
* Week = From Sunday 12:00 AM to Saturday 11:59 PM
* Month: From 12:00 AM on the first of a month until 11:59 PM on the last day of the same month

blocks.raw:
* **Daily**: Check to set a daily limit and enter the limit value in the respective box.\
  **Note** A default limit of 10 messages per user within 24-hour window is always enforced, even if no custom limit is configured. Any messages sent beyond this limit will be blocked until the 24-hour window resets. This limit applies across all the engagement channels. To increase this limit, raise a Jira ticket with the Product Support team. The updated limit will be applied within 24 hours.
* **Weekly**: Check this to set a weekly limit and enter the limit value. Example: 100 messages per week.
* **Monthly**: Check this to set a monthly limit and enter the limit value. Example: 2000 messages per month.

blocks.raw: ## Campaign alerts
blocks.text: Campaign alerts

blocks.raw: To alert users on message approval requests, low delivery rates, or execution failures, do the following:
blocks.text: To alert users on message approval requests, low delivery rates, or execution failures, do the following:

blocks.raw:
1. On the Engage+ home page, select the settings icon, and go to the **Alerts** page.
2. Go to the campaign alerts tab.
   The following configurations are available:

   | Configuration                   | Description                                                                                                                     |
   | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
   | Message execution failure alert | Notifies the users when a campaign message fails to execute.                                                                    |
   | Low message delivery alert      | Notifies the users when the message delivery rate is less than 60%.                                                             |
   | Message approval request        | Notifies the users when a new campaign message is sent for approval.                                                            |
   | Recurring message expiry alert  | Notifies the users when a [recurring campaign](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/recurring-campaign#/) is approaching expiry. |
3. Select the users to notify from the dropdown. The dropdown lists the points of contact (POCs) for the organisation. For more information, refer to the documentation on [Organisation POCs](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/org-management#/organization-point-of-contact-tab).
4. Enter the number of days before the expiry date to receive the alert.

blocks.raw: # Test customers
blocks.text: Test customers

blocks.raw: Test customers are sample users or groups used for testing purposes, allowing you to test messages and workflows before they are sent to real customers. This feature is available across Engage+.
blocks.text: Test customers are sample users or groups used for testing purposes, allowing you to test messages and workflows before they are sent to real customers. This feature is available across Engage+.

blocks.raw: ## Creating test customers
blocks.text: Creating test customers

blocks.raw: To create the test customers, perform the following:
blocks.text: To create the test customers, perform the following:

blocks.raw:
1. From the **Engage+** homepage, click on  **Settings icon** and then select **Test Customers**.
2. Select **Individuals** or **Groups**.
3. For individuals, perform the following:
   1. Search for the desired contact using their identifiers in the text field.
   2. Click on **Add**.
4. For Groups, perform the following:
   1. Select **Create test group**.
   2. Enter a group name.
   3. Search for the desired contact using their identifiers in the text field. There is no limit in the number of customers that you can add.
   4. Click on **Add to group**.
5. Select **Done** to save the changes.
